Playable capacity from stated time, closures, or an optional weather scenario

Source: R/weather.R
playable_capacity.Rd

theoretical_capacity is the capacity column you pass in. This function does not change course_capacity() or rounds_possible.

Usage

playable_capacity(
  data,
  capacity = "rounds_possible",
  calendar = NULL,
  unavailable_hours = NULL,
  daylight_hours = NULL,
  unavailable_fraction = NULL,
  weather = NULL,
  precip_unplayable_mm = NULL,
  precip_column = "precip_mm",
  wind_unplayable_ms = NULL,
  wind_column = "wind_speed_ms"
)

Arguments

data

A table with date and the capacity column.

capacity

Column name of theoretical capacity, in rounds.

calendar

Optional operating_calendar().

unavailable_hours, daylight_hours

Column names. Both are required together. Hours cannot exceed daylight hours.

unavailable_fraction

Column name of a stated fraction from 0 to 1.

weather

Optional course_weather() or prepare_dobson_weather() table. Used only when a precipitation or wind threshold is set.

precip_unplayable_mm

Positive precipitation threshold, in millimeters. NULL skips the scenario.

precip_column

Precipitation column on weather. The name must end in _mm.

wind_unplayable_ms

Positive wind threshold, in meters per second. NULL skips the scenario.

wind_column

Wind column on weather. The name must end in _ms.

Value

A golfops_playable_capacity tibble. The attribute assumptions states which rules were applied.

Details

The primary adjustments are a confirmed closure, a stated unavailable fraction, or stated unavailable hours. Hours reduce theoretical capacity in proportion to daylight hours. Those hours come from the table. They are not inferred from a daily weather total.

A precipitation or wind threshold is a separate scenario. On a day that meets it, playable capacity is set to zero for the whole day and the source is weather_assumption. Lost hours stay missing. Pass that scenario in its own call, not together with stated hours or a stated fraction. High temperature is not an input and does not reduce capacity.

A calendar status of closed sets playable capacity to zero and is recorded as observed_closure. That status wins over a weather scenario on the same date.

Examples

day <- data.frame(
  date = as.Date("2024-07-01"),
  rounds_possible = 240,
  daylight_hours = 14,
  unavailable_hours = 3
)
playable_capacity(
  day,
  unavailable_hours = "unavailable_hours",
  daylight_hours = "daylight_hours"
)
#> Playable capacity
#> - theoretical_capacity is the capacity column passed into this function. course_capacity() and rounds_possible are not modified.
#> - High temperature does not reduce playable capacity. Temperature can be compared with rounds when the question is demand.
#> - Unavailable hours reduce theoretical capacity in proportion to daylight hours. The hours are a statement in the table. They are not calculated from precipitation, wind, or temperature.
#> - A stated fraction is applied as given. It is not inferred from a daily weather total.
#> 
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   date       theoretical_capacity playable_capacity unavailable_fraction_applied
#>   <date>                    <dbl>             <dbl>                        <dbl>
#> 1 2024-07-01                  240              189.                        0.214
#> # ℹ 4 more variables: unavailable_hours_stated <dbl>, restriction <chr>,
#> #   restriction_source <chr>, weather_assumption_met <lgl>
